test_cases.rationale: Happy path login with valid credentials should return 200 with a token response.
Missing required username field should trigger validation error 422.
Missing required password field should trigger validation error 422.
Empty payload with no fields should trigger validation error 422.
Empty string values for username and password should be rejected as invalid.
Invalid credentials should return an unauthorized error, typically 401.
Numeric values instead of strings for username and password should fail validation.
Health endpoint should always return 200 with no authentication required.
Happy path get tasks with a valid authorization header should return 200 with a list of tasks.
Getting tasks without any authorization header should be rejected as unauthorized.
Getting tasks with an invalid or expired token should be rejected as unauthorized.
Empty authorization header value should be treated as unauthenticated.
Happy path create task with valid token and required fields should return 200 with created task.
Creating a task with only the title field should succeed if description is optional.
Creating a task with an empty payload should fail if title is required.
Creating a task with an empty string title should fail validation.
Creating a task without an authorization header should be rejected as unauthorized.
Creating a task with an invalid token should be rejected as unauthorized.
Providing a numeric value for title instead of a string should fail validation.
Creating a task with a very long title tests boundary behavior for string length.
Happy path get task by valid integer ID with valid token should return 200 with task data.
Requesting a task with a non-existent ID should return 404 not found.
Providing a non-integer string as task_id should trigger validation error 422.
Task ID of 0 is a boundary value and likely does not exist, expecting 404.
Getting a specific task without authorization header should be rejected as unauthorized.
Getting a specific task with an invalid token should be rejected as unauthorized.
Happy path update task with valid token, valid ID, and valid fields should return 200.
Partial update with only title field should succeed if other fields are optional.
Update task with empty payload should fail if at least one required field is expected.
Updating a non-existent task ID should return 404 not found.
Updating a task without authorization header should be rejected as unauthorized.
Updating a task with an invalid token should be rejected as unauthorized.
Providing a non-integer string as task_id in PUT should trigger validation error 422.
Providing a numeric value for title in update should fail validation with 422.
Happy path delete task with valid token and existing task ID should return 200.
Deleting a non-existent task ID should return 404 not found.
Deleting a task without authorization header should be rejected as unauthorized.
Deleting a task with an invalid token should be rejected as unauthorized.
Providing a non-integer string as task_id in DELETE should trigger validation error 422.
Task ID of 0 is a boundary edge case and likely does not exist, expecting 404.
Negative task ID is an invalid edge case and should return 404 or 422.
Deleting with a negative task ID is an edge case that should return 404 or 422.
Creating a task with optional boolean completed field set to true should succeed.
Providing a string instead of boolean for completed field should fail validation.
Updating a task with an empty title string should fail validation.
Null value for username should fail validation with 422 as the field expects a string type
Null value for password should fail validation with 422 as the field expects a string type
Sending login request with wrong Content-Type should be rejected since the endpoint expects application/json
Malformed JSON body should return a validation or parse error rather than 200
Authorization header without the Bearer prefix is malformed and should be rejected as unauthorized
Null value for the title field should fail validation since title is expected to be a string
Non-string type for description field should fail validation with 422
Creating a task with completed explicitly set to false should succeed and confirms the false boolean value is handled correctly alongside the true case in TC-491DCD9C
Null value for title in a PUT update request should fail validation with 422
Updating only the completed boolean field should succeed if all TaskUpdate fields are optional, confirming partial update behavior for boolean fields
Deleting the same task a second time (idempotency test) should return 404 since the resource no longer exists after the first deletion
Very large integer task_id tests upper boundary behavior and should return 404 for a non-existent resource without causing server errors
Very large integer task_id on PUT should return 404 without causing server overflow or 500 errors
Very large integer task_id on DELETE should return 404 without causing server overflow or 500 errors
Float/decimal value for task_id path parameter should fail validation since task_id expects an integer type
The /health endpoint only supports GET; sending a POST request should return 405 Method Not Allowed to confirm proper HTTP method enforcement
When no tasks exist for the authenticated user the response should still be 200 with an empty array rather than 404, validating the empty collection response behavior
Single character username and password that do not match any valid credentials tests minimum length boundary and invalid credential rejection simultaneously
Extra unknown fields in the login payload should either be ignored and return 200 or be rejected; this verifies the API's handling of additional properties
Malformed authorization header without Bearer prefix on POST /tasks should be rejected as unauthorized, covering the malformed token edge case for write operations
